description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/dns/records (base $0.002; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?name=example.com&type=A (one name, one type). DNS lookup for one name and one record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, SRV, PTR): answers, TTLs and response code as our resolver received them at query time. Answers can differ by resolver, location and time. No zone transfers or bulk enumeration. A resolver-confirmed NXDOMAIN or empty NODATA answer is charged. Bad input, timeout, SERVFAIL, REFUSED or resolver failure: not charged. USDC on Base only.
